title: `RewardsDistributor` calculation doesn't work properly
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The owner of the `RewardsDistributor` contract can set boost periods for higher reward multipliers by calling `setBoostPeriods`. These periods are used in the `rewardRate` logic when calculating the current reward rate and by association the reward per token.  As suggested in an example by the sponsor, a common configuration for such boost periods is to have the multiplier decrease over time with a series of boost periods.
